lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The fire is small, and {mc} keeps it that way. Hunters look for light.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: You spoke on the road. Speak now, if you're going to.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: You sleep with your hand on my hilt. She did the same, at the end.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: Someone who carried me farther than she should have. Ask her bones, if you want more.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: I buried her with a borrowed shovel and no name.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: There are nine of us left, scattered. Each one is louder than me. Find them before he does.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: And if I'd rather throw you in the river?

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: Then you would wake up holding me. Feed the fire. You will need the warmth.
